title: Phase Space Error Control for Dynamical Systems II
read_scope: Abstract, Introduction and Sections 2, 5.2 and 7; relevant text and figure captions, not a full review of all 34 pages.
finding: Section 5.2 explicitly connects numerical rotations near pi with perturbed oscillation and chaotic-looking dynamics, and examines DOPRI5(4) stability/phase regions. The report also gives standard-DOPRI spurious fixed-point examples and norm-dependent irregular step sequences.
consequence: Neither alternating orbit bands nor irregular-looking Dormand-Prince trajectories constitute a new mechanism claim. No exact D335 hyperchaotic invariant-set classification identified in the inspected sections.

additional_visual_review.finding: Printed p20 explicitly connects phase near pi with perturbed oscillation and chaotic-looking dynamics. Figures 6-9 concern stability/acceptable regions, not invariant clouds. Numerical examples inspected do not supply a matching full-state portrait. This is still not an exhaustive full-report review.
